description: Request screening of company or person names against the EU consolidated financial sanctions list and the UN Security Council list. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Hypothesis: EUR 0.50–3 per name; human-reviewed matches from EUR 5.

additional_data.description: Optional: countries, dates of birth, registration numbers to reduce false positives.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

purpose.description: Purpose of the screening (e.g. supplier onboarding).
